get.summary: Token usage facts for the authenticated caller; [from,to) ordered by (recorded_at,request_id)
get.description: Token usage facts. With a data credential the caller sees only its own records; with the admin credential the response includes all principals. The first page persists an expiring snapshot of exact request_id/record_version members. Cursor is bound to principal, current authorization and the exact original filters. Revisions and inserts after page one are visible only to a new snapshot. Expired cursors return 400 cursor_expired; a cursor belonging to another principal or whose authorization digest does not match returns 403 permission_denied; a cursor whose filters do not match the original query returns 400 invalid_request. One logical record exists per server request_id; revisions replace, never add to, the earlier fact.

x-llmtier-contract-aliases.description: The management/observation contract (llmtier-management-contract-v0.3) mounts a small set of routes under the /tier/admin/v1/* prefix. The implementation serves each of those routes at BOTH /tier/admin/v1/* and the flat /v1/* path documented in this document; the two prefixes are exact aliases backed by the same handler with identical request and response shapes. Paths in this document are canonical.
